_note: Approvals for the automatic import after a deploy (what a person would tick on the Import screen). Every warning class needs a reason; every large change needs its record ID in large; missing records need a decision in missing (ID: removed_from_game, draft or ignore).

warnings.community_required: Seed data from the Fandom wiki (CC BY-SA). Values show 'Source: community wiki'; owner decision 2026-10-23: pages index on wiki data once Ali has reviewed our own note (notes_reviewed_by=ali), no in-game screenshot required.
warnings.rarity_order: Wiki values kept as reported; flagged for Ali's in-game check list.
warnings.meta_provenance: calc_defaults is our own editorial choice, not a game fact.
warnings.large_change: Light Dove and Flame Sprite base income fixed from 225 to 225000: our seed dropped the 'k' from the wiki's $225k/s (the egg's cash reward on the wiki is 100x that value, like every other biome egg). 2026-10-25: four base incomes follow the wiki pet data module (admin-protected, edited 24 Oct 2026): Night Fang 4M to 160K (matches its 16M egg reward, so a correction), Toxic Hedgehog 1.75B to 1.75M (wiki typo fix, correction), Spirit World Guardian 26B to 15B and Voidseer Pumpkin 12.5B to 14B (wiki changed both; not tied to an update because the game did not say).
warnings.outlier: Egg spawn chances (spawn_chance_prob, 2026-10-24) are per-biome shares from the wiki Drop Rates list (game files). They do not follow rarity across biomes, so rarity outlier flags are expected.
warnings.slug_change: 2026-10-25: the wiki renamed Abomination Kong to Gorillastein (same pet, same income). The record keeps its ID; the old pet and egg slugs stay in slug_history so the old URLs 301 to the new ones.
